description: Quote the BTC cost (in sats) of a CUSTOM value for a DYNAMIC (range) product before buying — GET /v4/products/price. Use for is_dynamic products (from wallet_list_giftcard_products) whose value you choose within min..max; fixed products already carry their `price_sats`. Gated on giftcardEnabled. Read-only, moves no money.

brand_name.description: Brand/family name of a RANGE (dynamic) product.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Defaults to the shop config country.

face_value.description: The custom face value to quote (within the product's min..max), in the product's fiat currency.

name: wallet_giftcard_price

currency.description: Fiat currency code, when the price response carries it (else null).

price_sats.description: BTC cost in sats for the requested custom value.

title: Price a custom gift-card value
